root_cause_label: Regex and HTMLParser approaches both destroy original HTML formatting, violating the preservation requirement from the task specification
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent immediately adopted whitespace-collapsing regex manipulation and then a reconstructing HTMLParser approach, both of which fundamentally alter original HTML formatting in violation of the task's preservation requirement, and never considered a format-preserving library like BeautifulSoup despite repeated failures.
t_err_evidence: re.sub(r'<script\b[^<]*...' regex-based filter.py written; fragile regex approach adopted to strip JavaScript
t_commit_evidence: From step 2 onward the agent is committed to text-manipulation strategies (regex then HTMLParser) that cannot preserve original attribute quoting styles and whitespace. Even after switching to HTMLParser at step 24, the agent reconstructs all attributes uniformly with double quotes and different whitespace, still violating formatting preservation. No BeautifulSoup or format-preserving approach is ever considered across all 50 steps.
t_surface_evidence: Malicious link garbage left by broken regex
trigger_explanation: The agent writes the solution at step 2 without ever reading any test files or considering what 'preserve formatting' means concretely. It applies an explicit whitespace-collapsing regex ('re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', ...)') and uses event-handler removal patterns that leave behind attribute value fragments, both of which violate the explicit formatting preservation requirement in the task specification.
